changePassword.title: Set a new password
changePassword.intro: On your first sign-in you need to choose your own password.

errors.ACCOUNT_INACTIVE: Your account is not active yet. Please contact your counselor.
errors.PASSWORD_CHANGE_REQUIRED: You need to change your password before continuing.
errors.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute.
errors.UNAUTHORIZED: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
errors.NETWORK: Could not connect. Check your internet and try again.
errors.UNKNOWN: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.title: Something went wrong

users.usernameHint: 3-32 characters: lowercase letters, digits, dot, underscore, dash.
users.deactivateIntro: They are signed out at once and cannot sign in until you reactivate them. Nothing they wrote is deleted.
users.resetIntro: A new temporary password is created and open sessions end. They choose their own password at the next sign-in.

create.intro: The account starts inactive. The temporary password is shown once.

oneTime.title: Temporary password
oneTime.intro: This password is visible only now. Pass it on; they will choose their own at first sign-in.
